runOrder: every tab but Audio in the tab-bar order, then Audio alone, on the same page: without a user gesture (the runner's in-page tab.click() is not one) Audio setup never reaches its 4th check, which calls engine.audio.suspend() then resume() (most likely AudioContext.resume(), which Safari's autoplay policy holds until a gesture; the exact point was not measured), and the SectionSwitcher (one switch at a time) would hold every later tab on the Audio panel (see attempt1BlockedByAudio in m12-tabs-B.json)
